1: // Asteroid Dodge game for <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   // Player ship
10:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2 - 20, y: height - 30, speed: 5 };
11: 
12:   // Asteroid pool
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   let asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
15:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
16:   let lastTime = 0;
17:   let score = 0;
18:   let gameOver = false;
19: 
20:   function spawnAsteroid() {
21:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
22:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1 + score * 0.02; // accelerate over time
23:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed });
24:   }
25: 
26:   function update(dt) {
27:     // Move ship based on keyboard
28:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
29:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
30: 
31:     // Update asteroids
32:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
33:       const a = asteroids[i];
34:       a.y += a.speed * dt;
35:       // collision
36:       if (
37:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.size > ship.x &&
38:         a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.size > ship.y
39:       ) {
40:         gameOver = true;
41:       }
42:       // off-screen
43:       if (a.y > height) {
44:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
45:         if (!gameOver) score++;
46:       }
47:     }
48: 
49:     // spawn logic
50:     asteroidSpawnTimer += dt;
51:     if (asteroidSpawnTimer > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
52:       spawnAsteroid();
53:       asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
54:       // gradually increase spawn rate
55:       asteroidSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, asteroidSpawnInterval * 0.985);
56:     }
57:   }
58: 
59:   function draw() {
60:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
61:     // ship
62:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
63:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
64:     // asteroids
65:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
66:     for (const a of asteroids) {
67:       ctx.beginPath();
68:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
69:       ctx.fill();
70:     }
71:     // score
72:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
73:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
74:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`,
75:       10, 20);
76:     if (gameOver) {
77:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
78:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
79:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
80:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
81:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
82:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
83:     }
84:   }
85: 
86:   const keys = {};
87:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
88:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
89: 
90:   function loop(timestamp) {
91:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
92:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 16.666; // normalize to ~60fps units
93:     lastTime = timestamp;
94:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
95:     draw();
96:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
97:   }
98:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
99: })();
